I can help you with that. Since your monstera arrived with a snapped main stem, that's **Damaged on Arrival (DOA)** and qualifies for a free replacement.

Here's what to do: **Report it within 48 hours of delivery** (you're at 3 days, so you've passed the window). However, since plant damage after 48 hours goes through our **Plant Care Guarantee** instead, I'll need to escalate this to a Support Lead who can review your specific situation and authorize an exception—snapped stems are clear damage, and they should be able to help.

Can you provide **two photos** (whole plant and close-up of the snapped stem)? That will speed up the review.
